findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the writer lock
findings.body: A caller that observes a nil cache on the read path unconditionally reloads the manifest after it eventually acquires the writer lock. If several callers observe nil before the first caller obtains that lock, they will each parse the manifest serially and overwrite an already populated cache. A burst of initial requests can therefore be delayed by N serialized disk reads rather than sharing the first initialization. Recheck `entryPointAssetsCache` under the write lock for non-development requests before loading the manifest; development mode can retain its intentional reload behavior.
